facts.text: The hotel stands over the slopes of the Bosphorus in the Mecidiyeköy business district.
facts.excerpt: Fairmont Quasar Istanbul stands tall in the city center – over the slopes of the Bosphorus in the Mecidiyeköy business district

facts.text: The hotel's location gives close access to both the European and Asian sides of Istanbul.
facts.excerpt: offering close access to both European and Asian sides of the metropolis

facts.text: Rooms and suites have floor-to-ceiling windows over Istanbul's skyline.
facts.excerpt: With floor-to-ceiling windows over Istanbul’s skyline

facts.text: Guests can choose a bathtub or a private Turkish bath in the standard rooms, which also have rain showers.
facts.excerpt: rain showers and your choice of bathtub or private Turkish bath

facts.text: The one-bedroom Bosphorus View suites have a private balcony and Gold Lounge access.
facts.excerpt: Luxury living space ideal for longer stays, with view of the Bosphorus. Gold Lounge Access, private balcony

facts.text: The Bosphorus Terrace Suite has a terrace with panoramic Bosphorus views and a dining table for six.
facts.excerpt: Large living area and a dining table for six, with a beautiful terrace offering panoramic views of the Bosphorus.

facts.text: Fairmont Gold guests have a private lounge with complimentary treats through the day and a dedicated butler team.
facts.excerpt: Unwind in the Fairmont Gold Lounge and enjoy complimentary treats throughout the day while our dedicated butler team will be at your service

facts.text: Fairmont Spa has swimming pools, a fitness center, treatment rooms and a traditional hammam.
facts.excerpt: Fairmont Spa, our luxury wellness retreat with swimming pools, fitness center, treatment rooms and a traditional hammam.

facts.text: A heated indoor pool is located at Fairmont Spa.
facts.excerpt: a heated (28.5°C) indoor pool located at Fairmont Spa

facts.text: The infinity pool is seasonal and open only during the summer months.
facts.excerpt: a seasonal infinity pool (only open during summer months)

facts.text: The hotel offers a Turkish hammam ritual called Luxury Hammam by gülsha.
facts.excerpt: experiencing a luxury Turkish hammam ritual, offering a glorious sensory journey combining gülsha’s most natural products

facts.text: The hotel is pet-friendly and has a Canine Ambassador named Gofret.
facts.excerpt: Fairmont Quasar Istanbul is a pet-friendly hotel and has been greeting its visitors along with their Canine Ambassador named Gofret.

facts.text: Guests can use the parking facilities themselves or use valet service.
facts.excerpt: Guests may prefer to use the facilities on their own or choose to take advantage of the valet services.

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler lists the hotel among its Readers' Choice Awards for 2019 and 2023.
